items.difficulty_reason: Resolution property propagates along f-ample morphisms: takes joint surjections s_i : L^{n_i}|_U -> F|_U over an affine etale V -> Y (ample characterization), regards s_i as sections of H_{-n_i} = f_*(F ⊗ L^{n_i}) over V, extracts finite-type submodules H'_i containing the sections via the limits lemma, and uses the resolution property of Y to get surjections E_i -> H'_i, whose pullbacks f^*E_i ⊗ L^{n_i} -> F are jointly surjective.
